lessons.name: The one the standard gets exactly right: open one stop of aperture and shorten one stop of shutter and the exposure is unchanged — (1) + (−1) = 0. Reciprocity is exact because it is pure addition of stops.
lessons.why: The one the standard gets exactly right: open one stop of aperture and shorten one stop of shutter and the exposure is unchanged — (1) + (−1) = 0. Reciprocity is exact because it is pure addition of stops.

lessons.name: The physics uuidna keeps: a full stop is EXACTLY a doubling, so the exact shutter after 1/64 is 1/128 = 2⁷ — a power of two.
lessons.why: The physics uuidna keeps: a full stop is EXACTLY a doubling, so the exact shutter after 1/64 is 1/128 = 2⁷ — a power of two.

lessons.name: WHERE uuidna and the standard AGREE: the full-stop ISO scale is EXACT doublings, no rounding — ISO 100 up five stops is 100·2⁵ = 3200, and the standard prints 3200. Sensitivity doubles cleanly; only shutter and aperture carry the rounding.
lessons.why: WHERE uuidna and the standard AGREE: the full-stop ISO scale is EXACT doublings, no rounding — ISO 100 up five stops is 100·2⁵ = 3200, and the standard prints 3200. Sensitivity doubles cleanly; only shutter and aperture carry the rounding.

lessons.name: WHERE uuidna DIFFERS: the camera prints 1/125 s, but the exact doubling is 1/128 s (2⁷) — the standard ROUNDS 128 down to 125, off by 3. uuidna keeps 128; the dial keeps the round number.
lessons.why: WHERE uuidna DIFFERS: the camera prints 1/125 s, but the exact doubling is 1/128 s (2⁷) — the standard ROUNDS 128 down to 125, off by 3. uuidna keeps 128; the dial keeps the round number.

lessons.name: The same rounding again: 1/60 s is the printed value; the exact stop is 1/64 s (2⁶). The standard rounds 64 to 60, off by 4 — uuidna computes the power of two the dial approximates.
lessons.why: The same rounding again: 1/60 s is the printed value; the exact stop is 1/64 s (2⁶). The standard rounds 64 to 60, off by 4 — uuidna computes the power of two the dial approximates.

lessons.name: What uuidna keeps exact: the aperture AREA is powers of two, so f² = 2ⁿ exactly — [1,2,4,8,16] = [2⁰..2⁴]. The printed f-numbers (1, 1.4, 2, 2.8, 4) are the rounded √ of these; the squares are exact.
lessons.why: What uuidna keeps exact: the aperture AREA is powers of two, so f² = 2ⁿ exactly — [1,2,4,8,16] = [2⁰..2⁴]. The printed f-numbers (1, 1.4, 2, 2.8, 4) are the rounded √ of these; the squares are exact.

lessons.name: The aperture rounds too: f/1.4 is the printed √2, but 1.4² = 1.96, short of the exact 2 (14² = 196 < 200). One stop of AREA is exactly ×2; the f-number the standard engraves is a rounded √2.
lessons.why: The aperture rounds too: f/1.4 is the printed √2, but 1.4² = 1.96, short of the exact 2 (14² = 196 < 200). One stop of AREA is exactly ×2; the f-number the standard engraves is a rounded √2.

lessons.name: Why the doubling is uuidna's: the exposure light-multipliers 2⁰..2⁵, folded mod 9, ARE the vortex sequence — (List.range 6).map (2^· mod 9) = [1,2,4,8,7,5]. The camera doubles in the same ring uuidna turns on; the standard just rounds the readout.
